_note: The Interview (DESIGN.md §2): character creation as a talk show segment. Oprah interviews the player about themselves; answers drive SPECIAL-style stat allocation (Fallout G.O.A.T.-exam register). 'stats' lists the stat ids/labels; 'base' and 'min'/'max' bound each stat; 'questions' is the interview, in order: each is {"prompt": text, "answers": [{"text": text, "stats": {stat_id: delta}}]} (up to 8 answers per question). Content is the author's and ships empty. Oprah's own lines must come from data/quotes/oprah.json. When the questions run out the stats are written to WorldState (stats, interview_done).
title: The Interview
